image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a baby lying on its back on a beige carpet. The baby is wearing a disposable diaper with a light blue and yellow pattern. The baby's legs are bent at the knees, and one hand is visible near the face. A large, pale green blanket or cushion partially covers the baby's torso and head area. In the background, there is a grey sofa.
